concerns.text: FR‑001 requires the primary dataset to be downloaded from the Zenodo archive as stated in the specification. Task T001 acquires data via the Materials Project API, which contradicts the spec’s data‑source requirement and constitutes a scope‑creep violation of the constitution.

Tasks T001 and T002 do not carry explicit `[FR‑001]` or `[FR‑002]` tags (or any FR tags) linking them to the functional requirements they are meant to satisfy. This weakens traceability and risks dropping acceptance criteria, violating the constraint‑preservation rule that every FR/SC must be clearly covered.

Task T003 (“Thin end‑to‑end run (quick check)”) is not referenced by any functional requirement or success criterion in the specification, making it an orphan task. It adds effort without a documented purpose and should either be tied to an FR/SC or removed.
